bullets: Updated Freebuff CLI to 0.2.4, storing your login token in your OS keychain instead of a plain file and keeping the model catalog current from Freebuff's servers.
Updated Freebuff CLI to 0.2.5, locking your login file to be readable only by you on compatible systems and cleaning up repeated login errors.
Updated Freebuff CLI to 0.2.6, making MiMo 2.6 Flash the default model across CLI, desktop, web, and SDK and retiring GLM 5.3 Flash from the featured default position.
Fixed the landing screen to show a distinct ID-verification message instead of the daily-reset notice when the server requires identity verification.
Fixed the model picker to show only models that are ready for use, hiding ones scheduled for future release until they become available.
Fixed model price sorting so discounted models sort by their regular price on ties, matching Desktop and Web ordering.
Fixed the freebucks first-tab discount to read from the same Desktop purchase store on model switches, applying the discount after ending the current purchase.
Fixed the streak-clock display to label times with your local time and only shrink labels when the line is too wide for the terminal.
Added terminal output sanitization that strips escape sequences like clipboard writes and window titles from command output before rendering.
Fixed the SDK read-URL tool to validate DNS addresses before connecting, refusing private or internal addresses.
Fixed the landing screen to always enable ads with forceStart, removing the compact-height floor that previously hid them.
Fixed the launcher to install completed background updates on the next start when the terminal closes before installation.
Updated Freebuff CLI to 0.2.11, bumping the launcher staging and manifest version for deferred update handling.
Added a /todo slash command that opens a live checklist panel showing the agent's current tasks.
Fixed programmatic scrolling so wheel events remain responsive when auto-scrolling to the bottom.
Removed Kimi K3 Eco from the subscriber model catalog because its provider was retired.
Removed the GLM 5.3 Flash deal-ending notice now that the September 30 promotion has concluded.
Added a new billboard ad placement format with artwork size and shape rules for Desktop slots.
